column1: # INV-T-4909. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-85, 331, 333, 335, 877, 956, 1245
# (read from Keel). One row per identifier, under the first requirement that names it; INV-REQ-333 names the
# three Excluded values and excludedBusinessStatus, INV-REQ-335 names obligationStartDate.
# Not listed, because they are not tenancy contract identifiers: entity.admin, tenant.admin, tax.approver (roles);
# tenancy-svc, console-bff, console-web, config-resolver (services); setPolicy (owning services' contracts);
# confirmFiling (submission/openapi.yaml). Open: offboardTenant (INV-REQ-877, INV-REQ-956) is not an operation of this
# contract; the exit is deregisterEntity plus exportTenantData. Listing it would fail this check until the owner rules.
